source.detail: Remove support for proof_of_registration on AccountCreateParamsDocument; field was limited-use and is being deprecated

spec_evidence.checked: Token-level verification against the published OpenAPI spec (upgraded 2026-07-30): stripe/openapi tag v2349 is the first tag pinning API version 2026-07-29.dahlia (v2344-v2348 all still pin 2026-06-24.dahlia). specdiff on v2348 -> v2349 emits 4 breaking request-prop-removed records for POST /v1/accounts at documents.proof_of_registration (including .files and .signer sub-props), while POST /v1/accounts/{account} retains the property - exactly matching the stripe-python v15.4.0 release wording that only AccountCreateParams loses the field. Original cross-confirmation (independent stripe-node v22.4.0 and stripe-python v15.4.0 release feeds naming the identical removal) remains on record as the initial adjudication basis.

alternative_data_source: Registration proof uploads continue via the Stripe Dashboard onboarding flow and the account onboarding AccountLink; only the typed create-param slot is removed

fix.migration_guide: Mechanical removal at write sites. Search the repo for stripe.Account.create calls whose documents dict carries a proof_of_registration key (including TypedDict usages of AccountCreateParamsDocument). Delete that key from the params dict; if the file uploads backing it feed only this slot, drop the upload step too. After upgrading to stripe-python >=15.4.0, type checkers (mypy/pyright) flag remaining TypedDict usages, and the API itself rejects the param on the 2026-07-29.dahlia version, so a typecheck plus one integration call verifies the migration. No replacement param exists: registration proof is collected through hosted onboarding instead.
